description: Save a finished reply draft for a ticket. Saving a draft does NOT send anything: every draft waits for a human to approve it before it can be sent. Returns the draft id and its status. Call this once the reply text is final.

errors.returns: An error saying ticket_ref is required and what it looks like.
An error saying an empty draft cannot be saved and to write the reply first.

draft_text.description: The complete reply text, exactly as the customer would read it after approval. No placeholders.

revision_of.description: Optional: the draft_id this draft replaces (used when the reflection pass revises a saved draft).

ticket_ref.description: What the draft answers: the ticket or order reference from the conversation, e.g. 'ticket about ORD-1042'.

name: create_draft_reply
